xmlRec.abstract: METHODS: In this phase 3 trial, adults received mazdutide 6 mg or placebo for 48 weeks. The coprimary end points were percentage change in body weight and weight reduction of 5% or more. xmlRec.title: Phase 3 cardiovascular outcomes trial of semaglutide.
xmlRec.abstract: METHODS: In this phase 3 cardiovascular outcomes trial, 17604 adults were randomized to semaglutide 2.4 mg or placebo. RESULTS: A primary cardiovascular end-point event occurred in 6.5% in the semaglutide group versus 8.0% in the placebo group (hazard ratio, 0.80; 95% confidence interval, 0.72 to 0.90; P<0.001).
